details: For every finite binary concept class, combinatorial eluder dimension directly dominates VC dimension. The addressing family gives an unbounded separation: $\mathrm{Edim}=n-1$ while $\mathrm{VC}=\log_2 n$ under the standard $n=2^d$ convention.
proof: If S={x_1,...,x_d} is shattered, choose as base a hypothesis with label 0 on S. At step i, shattering supplies a hypothesis that is 1 at x_i and 0 at every earlier x_j. These form a sequential eluder witness of length d.
name: Combinatorial Eluder Dimension / VC Dimension
